references.text: The Pharisees and scribes criticize Jesus' disciples for not washing their hands before eating, which is similar to the criticism in Mark 7:2.
Rituals of handwashing mentioned in connection with clean and unclean actions, which may relate to the practice described in Mark 7:2.
Criticism of those who honor God with their lips but have hearts far from him can be seen in connection with the Pharisees' focus on external purity in Mark 7:2.
